questions.def: Reported command: 'Don't be late' becomes 'She told me not to be late'.
questions.question: She told me ___ late.

questions.def: Reported request: 'Help me' becomes 'He asked me to help him'.
questions.question: He asked me ___ him.

questions.def: 'Said me' is wrong; use 'told me' or 'said to me'.
questions.question: They said me to wait here yesterday.

questions.def: Negative reported request uses 'not to + verb'.
questions.question: She asked me ___ that again.

questions.def: Reported command: 'Be quiet' becomes 'The teacher told us to be quiet'.
questions.question: The teacher told us ___ quiet.

questions.def: Reported command requires 'to + infinitive'.
questions.question: My mom told me ___ my room.

questions.def: Reported request uses 'to + infinitive'.
questions.question: She asked me ___ with her.

questions.def: Negative reported command: 'Don't worry' becomes 'They told him not to worry'.
questions.question: They told him ___ worry.

questions.def: Reported request: 'Do me a favor' becomes 'I asked her to do me a favor'.
questions.question: I asked her ___ me a favor.

questions.def: Reported command requires 'to + infinitive': 'Eat all the cake'.
questions.question: He told them ___ all the cake.

questions.def: Reported command: 'Drink more water' becomes 'The doctor told him to drink more water'.

questions.def: We use 'not to + infinitive' to report negative commands.
questions.question: He told me ___ late.

questions.def: We use 'to + infinitive' after 'ask' to report requests.
questions.question: She asked me ___ the window.

questions.def: We use 'to + infinitive' after 'asked' to report a request.
questions.question: She asked him ___ her with her homework.

questions.def: Negative commands are reported with 'not to + infinitive'.
questions.question: They told us ___ so much noise.

questions.def: 'Told' is followed by 'to + infinitive' in reported commands.
questions.question: The teacher told the students ___ quiet.

questions.def: We use 'to + infinitive' after 'asked' in reported requests.
questions.question: She asked me ___ for her at the station.
